title: WaterSound "Eureka at WaterSound" 69 W Yacht Pond Lane
h1: WaterSound "Eureka at WaterSound" 69 W Yacht Pond Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Private pool *Pool heating is available October 1 through May 1st for an additional fee of $25 per day. - Community pool- 500 yards to the beach- 5 complimentary adult bikes- Screened-in porch- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Discover Eureka at WaterSound, a remarkable 3-level, 5-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 12 guests. Enjoy access to 2 community pools, a fitness center, and the WaterSound Puttering Park. Guests will love cooling off in the private pool and the quick beach access—only a 6-minute walk away!Exposed brick, rugged wood features, and tasteful décor combine inside this magnificent home’s first-floor great room. The ornate kitchen boasts high-end appliances and an island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 4. Opposite are 2 armchairs and a dry bar. The back of the room hosts the 6-person dining table and beautiful living space with a mounted TV, flanked by 4 armchairs and a sofa. Wander out to relax on the screened-in porch’s cushioned woven furniture. In the brick courtyard is a private pool, and there’s an outdoor shower by the door to the laundry room for ultimate convenience after beach trips. When it’s time to retire for the night, there is 1 guest bedroom with a king bed on this level—all the bedrooms feature a private bathroom.A 4-person table, 2 armchairs, and a desk await on the second-level landing, where guests can read, sip coffee, or check emails. In the luxurious primary bedroom, find a king bed and a private balcony furnished with soft patio seating, a comfy porch swing, and an overhead fan for comfort. Adjacent is a roomy office for mixing work and play. There are 2 guest bedrooms with a queen bed and a king bed, respectively. The spacious bunk room is a perfect hangout spot for kids and teens with 2 twin-over-twin beds, a beverage fridge, a sitting area with a TV, and balcony access.The third floor is the crowning gem with a large deck boasting bird’s-eye views of the neighborhood, bar seating at the railing, and a dry bar.Experience an exceptional getaway at Eureka at WaterSound. On-site garage parking for 2 vehicles, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 4-seat low-speed vehicle make it easy to explore. For beach access, follow the boardwalk beside the house to Coopersmith Lane and turn right on WaterSound Way. The boardwalk is past the Dunesider Pool. Book today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 12):FIRST FLOOR-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower Only-Additional Living Area: Office with Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Balcony with Gulf Views*This property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*The fireplace is not for guest use.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Watch Video WaterSound "Eureka at WaterSound" 69 W Yacht Pond Lane WaterSound, FL Bedrooms 5 Beds 8 Sleeps 12 Full Baths 6 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Gated Community with on-site Security - Private pool *Pool heating is available October 1 through May 1st for an additional fee of $25 per day. - Community pool - 500 yards to the beach - 5 complimentary adult bikes - Screened-in porch - From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella) - Private Deeded Beach Access - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Discover Eureka at WaterSound, a remarkable 3-level, 5-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that sleeps up to 12 guests. Enjoy access to 2 community pools, a fitness center, and the WaterSound Puttering Park. Guests will love cooling off in the private pool and the quick beach access—only a 6-minute walk away! Exposed brick, rugged wood features, and tasteful décor combine inside this magnificent home’s first-floor great room. The ornate kitchen boasts high-end appliances and an island that doubles as a breakfast bar for 4. Opposite are 2 armchairs and a dry bar. The back of the room hosts the 6-person dining table and beautiful living space with a mounted TV, flanked by 4 armchairs and a sofa. Wander out to relax on the screened-in porch’s cushioned woven furniture. In the brick courtyard is a private pool, and there’s an outdoor shower by the door to the laundry room for ultimate convenience after beach trips. When it’s time to retire for the night, there is 1 guest bedroom with a king bed on this level—all the bedrooms feature a private bathroom. A 4-person table, 2 armchairs, and a desk await on the second-level landing, where guests can read, sip coffee, or check emails. In the luxurious primary bedroom, find a king bed and a private balcony furnished with soft patio seating, a comfy porch swing, and an overhead fan for comfort. Adjacent is a roomy office for mixing work and play. There are 2 guest bedrooms with a queen bed and a king bed, respectively. The spacious bunk room is a perfect hangout spot for kids and teens with 2 twin-over-twin beds, a beverage fridge, a sitting area with a TV, and balcony access. The third floor is the crowning gem with a large deck boasting bird’s-eye views of the neighborhood, bar seating at the railing, and a dry bar. Experience an exceptional getaway at Eureka at WaterSound. On-site garage parking for 2 vehicles, 5 complimentary adult bikes, and a 4-seat low-speed vehicle make it easy to explore. For beach access, follow the boardwalk beside the house to Coopersmith Lane and turn right on WaterSound Way. The boardwalk is past the Dunesider Pool. Book today!
